produce.prompt_used: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate clean reusable standalone pixel-art wall painting assets for the APPROVED PokeCorner cozy pixel room, use references ONLY for visual style. Exactly FOUR separate small FRAMED PICTURES in spacious 2x2 arrangement, one whole frame per quadrant, large transparent margins and clear transparent gaps. All frames identical LANDSCAPE 5:4 outer aspect ratio, thin honey oak and dark walnut stepped molding, warm upper-left highlight, gently shaded bottom/right bevel. View almost straight-on like pictures on room BACK WALL, vertical edges straight, nearly horizontal top, tiny right-edge frame thickness only, NOT rotated isometric. Each painting has physical wooden rectangular frame as part of asset. NO wall, background, glow, floor, shadows outside frame, title, labels, letters, prices, captions, branding, watermarks, grid lines. All exterior pixels truly alpha0. Frame fully contains illustrated subject; every frame fully inside quadrant with at least12percent empty margin. Art itself matches detailed square-pixel clusters, warm brown outlines, sage greens, muted dusty blue and warm golden accents of reference. One distinct scene per frame, expressive beautiful pixel art with readable silhouettes at small room scale, not photorealistic or vector, NOT a UI design. Top-left: pictorial Kanto region map art, forests, mountain ridge, turquoise coastline and small connected town dots and routes, no words. Top-right: pictorial Johto region map art, autumn wooded valleys, connected villages, lakes and eastern mountain ridge, no words. Bottom-left: pictorial Hoenn region map art, a green island region amid deep dusty turquoise ocean, volcano landform and scattered small islands, no words. These are decorative artistic Pokémon region map illustrations, not cartographic documentation. Bottom-right: Pallet Town sunset landscape, a few small quiet cream cottages with red and slate roofs, green hedges beside an orange golden horizon over a distant sea, calm nostalgic warm light.
deviations: Landscape frame aspect approximately 1.34 to 1.39 rather than exact requested 5:4; use uniform scale only.
Decorative pictorial region art only; cartographic accuracy not verified.

semantic.implementation: Place separate framed RGBA image layers centered on three back-wall anchors; uniformly scale inside each frame slot maximum without stretching. Physical frame stays in raster; room surface, optional contact shadow and layer ordering remain code-owned.
semantic.notes: Use scene-contract.json. No drag-anywhere flow or baked labels. Responsive transform scales the whole room and its anchors together. Parent owns implementation.

execution_order: Inspect reference fidelity and composite over white to verify actual alpha
Slice with shared split-atlas.py preserving pixels
Record native dimensions and measured anchors
Parent reviews static composed scene combinations
assumptions: No application code or pet sprites are part of this handoff.
displayWidth is in 1000-wide scene units, scale uniformly per scene-contract limits.
Source atlases, rejected cleanup and QA white plates remain _sources only; consume assets only.
